quarterly_data.signal: FPT release on Deputy CEO Pham Minh Tuan's (CEO of FPT Software) talk at the Saigon Hi-Tech Park conference (October 16, 2026): FPT's AI Factories in Vietnam and Japan currently operate on GPU infrastructure, and starting in 2027 FPT plans to integrate quantum computers with GPUs to address large-scale optimization problems in finance, energy and logistics. FPT has identified five strategic technology areas in which it aims to develop technological mastery: quantum computing, cybersecurity, Physical AI and UAVs, big data, and railway technology; its education system serves 150,000 learners.
